title: Agentic Optimization: LLM Agents Select and Configure Algorithms for Engineering Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.31275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Engineers solving new multi-objective design problems commonly commit to a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) before seeing a result. The best MOEA differs from benchmark to benchmark. We propose agentic optimization, placing an LLM agent outside the optimization loop, where it reads a natural-language problem description to configure and launch algorithms, drawing on parametric knowledge rather than on a performance history that a novel problem lacks. We compare five LLMs in a fixed harness on four engineering benchmarks and a real-world SARS-CoV-2 molecular docking task, using hypervolume (HV) and IGD+ with multiple comparison-corrected tests. translated_title: 智能体优化：LLM智能体为工程设计选择与配置算法
translated_abstract: 工程师在解决新的多目标设计问题时，通常在看到结果之前就预先选定一种多目标进化算法（MOEA）。然而最优的MOEA因基准问题而异。我们提出智能体优化方法，将LLM智能体置于优化循环之外，由它读取自然语言问题描述来配置并启动算法，依靠其参数化知识，而非新问题所不具备的历史性能记录。我们在固定的测试框架下比较了五个LLM，在四个工程基准和一个真实的SARS-CoV-2分子对接任务上，使用超体积（HV）和IGD+指标以及多种比较校正检验进行评估。三个模型（GPT、DeepSeek、Qwen）在组合HV和IGD+指标上全面超越所有基线，且每个模型在至少一个基准上显著优于最佳基线，有时甚至是通过应用它们所超越的同一种基线算法来实现的，这凸显了算法配置的重要性。
tldr: 提出智能体优化方法，让LLM智能体通过阅读自然语言问题描述来配置和启动多目标优化算法，在四个工程基准和真实分子对接任务上全面超越固定算法基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes agentic optimization, where an LLM agent reads natural-language problem descriptions to configure and launch multi-objective optimization algorithms, consistently outperforming fixed algorithm baselines across engineering benchmarks and a real-world molecular docking task.
